rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_coronary_incidence(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result11 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result12 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result01 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result02 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result03 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result04 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result05 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result06 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result07 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result08 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result09 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_coronary_incidence WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_coronary_incidence 
(
SELECT
	 @id,v.hospcode,v.villcode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year,IFNULL(p.total,0) as pop
	,IFNULL(t.v,0),IFNULL(t.v10,0),IFNULL(t.v11,0),IFNULL(t.v12,0),IFNULL(t.v1,0),IFNULL(t.v2,0),IFNULL(t.v3,0)
  ,IFNULL(t.v4,0),IFNULL(t.v5,0),IFNULL(t.v6,0),IFNULL(t.v7,0),IFNULL(t.v8,0),IFNULL(t.v9,0)
FROM
cvillage_hosp v
LEFT JOIN
	(	SELECT villcode,SUM(total) total 
		FROM cmidyearpop 
		WHERE (SUBSTR(yearmonth,1,4)-543) = @b_year	AND SUBSTR(villcode,1,2) = @prov_c 	
		GROUP BY villcode 
	) as p  ON  v.villcode=p.villcode

LEFT JOIN
	(SELECT
	t2.d_hospcode,t2.d_pt_vhid
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(SUBSTR(date_dx,1,10),'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year-1,'1001') AND concat(@b_year,'0931')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year-1,'1001') AND concat(@b_year-1,'1031')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v10
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year-1,'1101') AND concat(@b_year-1,'1131')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v11
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year-1,'1201') AND concat(@b_year-1,'1231')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v12
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0101') AND concat(@b_year,'0131')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v1
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0201') AND concat(@b_year,'0231')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v2
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0301') AND concat(@b_year,'0331')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v3
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0401') AND concat(@b_year,'0431')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v4
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0501') AND concat(@b_year,'0531')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v5
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0601') AND concat(@b_year,'0631')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v6
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0701') AND concat(@b_year,'0731')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v7
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0801') AND concat(@b_year,'0831')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v8
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(date_dx,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year,'0901') AND concat(@b_year,'0931')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v9
	FROM
	(  SELECT *	FROM
		(	SELECT d.* FROM t_chronic d
			WHERE   ((substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I00' AND 'I09')
					OR (substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I20' AND 'I28')
					OR (substr(diagcode,1,3) BETWEEN 'I30' AND 'I52'))
			AND d.typedisch not in(1,2,7) AND d.nation=99 AND d.d_typearea in(1,3)
			ORDER BY cid,date_dx
		) as t1
	  GROUP BY cid
	) as t2 
	GROUP BY  t2.d_hospcode,t2.d_pt_vhid
	) as t ON v.villcode=t.d_pt_vhid
WHERE  (p.total >0 or t.v >0)
GROUP BY v.hospcode,v.villcode
ORDER BY villcode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("result10") as "result10" ,SUM("result11") as "result11" ,SUM("result12") as "result12" ,SUM("result01") as "result1" ,SUM("result02") as "result2" ,SUM("result03") as "result3" ,SUM("result04") as "result4" ,SUM("result05") as "result5" ,SUM("result06") as "result6" ,SUM("result07") as "result7" ,SUM("result08") as "result8" ,SUM("result09") as "result9" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT c.splevel as a_code ,c.splevel as a_name , SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("result10") as "result10" ,SUM("result11") as "result11" ,SUM("result12") as "result12" ,SUM("result01") as "result1" ,SUM("result02") as "result2" ,SUM("result03") as "result3" ,SUM("result04") as "result4" ,SUM("result05") as "result5" ,SUM("result06") as "result6" ,SUM("result07") as "result7" ,SUM("result08") as "result8" ,SUM("result09") as "result9" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON h.hoscode = c.hcode LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel
